# 06 Compose the pipeline behind a single public render() call

## Outcome

`render(source: string, container: HTMLElement): SirenRenderResult` runs the real
parse → buildGraphModel → layoutGraph → renderToSVG → createAnimationController pipeline end to
end, mounts the SVG into `container` on success, and always returns the aggregated diagnostics.
This ticket is the integration point — it is where the spec's top-level acceptance criteria
become directly testable through one public seam, using every other module's real implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

(Mirrors the spec's Acceptance criteria, minus the browser demo bullet, all exercised through
`render()` with real modules — no fixtures/fakes below the `TextMeasurer` seam.)

- [ ] Valid source (flowchart + `timeline:` with 2+ steps) → `render()` mounts an SVG into
  `container` with one `<g class="siren-node">` per declared node and one `<path class="siren-edge">`
  per declared edge, each carrying the correct `data-siren-id`.
- [ ] Elements assigned to step > 1 start with `siren-pending`; elements never mentioned in
  `timeline:` start without it.
- [ ] `result.controller.totalSteps` equals the highest step number declared (0 when there is no
  `timeline:` block, with everything immediately visible).
- [ ] `result.controller.next()` reveals exactly the newly-current step's elements and increments
  `currentStep`; calling it past the last step is a no-op.
- [ ] `result.controller.reset()` restores the initial pending state and `currentStep === 0`.
- [ ] A `timeline:` entry referencing an undeclared id produces an error diagnostic in
  `result.diagnostics`; `render()` does not throw, and the rest of the diagram still renders.
- [ ] A label containing `<script>...</script>` renders as literal visible text, never as markup.

## Test seam

`render(source: string, container: HTMLElement): SirenRenderResult` — integration test under
Vitest's jsdom environment, exercising the full real pipeline (no fakes except the internally
wired default `TextMeasurer`, which itself needs a real or jsdom-compatible measurement strategy —
see risk note below).

## Note

`layoutGraph` requires a `TextMeasurer`; jsdom does not implement real text metrics (`getBBox`,
`measureText` return zeros). `render()`'s default measurer needs a jsdom-safe fallback (e.g. a
fixed-width-per-character estimate) for this ticket's tests to produce sane, non-degenerate
layouts — the real canvas/DOM-based measurer is wired in ticket 07's browser demo instead. This
is a small implementation detail, not a spec change: `render()`'s `options.measureText` stays
overridable either way.
